items.label: SpaceX
items.headline: SpaceX is turning away customers for the rocket that flew most of 2025’s trips to orbit, and some are paying extra for the last seats
items.summary: Those who can afford it are paying extra to secure the few remaining slots on Falcon 9, while others are scrambling to find alternative launch opportunities.

items.label: SpaceX
items.headline: Falcon 9 ushered in the modern space economy – retiring it could leave the industry vulnerable
items.summary: SpaceX’s Falcon 9 rocket has allowed NASA, private companies, universities and nonprofits alike to launch satellites, spacecraft and even astronauts to orbit.
